claims: Mark Consuelos announced on the April 6, 2026, episode of Live with Kelly and Mark that his father, Saul Consuelos, passed away on March 23, 2026, following a long, unspecified illness.
Mark Consuelos noted that Saul Consuelos passed away peacefully.
Saul Consuelos passed away on March 23, 2026.
Saul Consuelos's cause of death was a long battle with an illness.
Saul Consuelos served in the U.S. Navy for 30 years.
Saul Consuelos was survived by his wife, Camilla.
Saul Consuelos was survived by his son, Mark Consuelos.
Mark Consuelos shared that he was able to say goodbye to Saul Consuelos.
